tools.name: apodexis_capabilities
tools.description: Return exercised capabilities of the standalone native C compiler: QBE-only code generation, no Python/Rust dependency, standard assembler/linker and kernel execution restrictions.

tools.name: apodexis_format
tools.description: Canonicalize complete UTF-8 Apodexis source; return canonical source plus exact-input source_text_hash and semantic source_hash. Postfix reads and P writeback expand to the established prefix canonical syntax. Does not prove type correctness or run tests. Each statement/expression must occupy one physical line; blocks use two-space indentation.

tools.name: apodexis_check
tools.description: Check complete source and return structured diagnostics, expected types for typed holes, and compiler-issued repairs. This does not execute tests or main. Use explicit L/S/R/P statements; a bare call is not a statement. Repair errors from the returned compiler facts, not invented syntax; use apodexis_verify for the final source. Maps use map T; immutable record updates use (with record field=value). Resolve imports with apodexis_bundle before checking.

tools.name: apodexis_explain
tools.description: Explain module facts and main JSON input/output contract for complete source. Main accepts zero or one parameter, with only implemented JSON boundary types. Missing/extra struct fields and malformed input are errors. This tool neither runs main nor proves tests pass.

tools.name: apodexis_test
tools.description: Run every source-declared X test under deterministic limits and return per-test status/diagnostics. Assertions are A bool_expression inside X blocks. A successful empty test list is not behavioral evidence. Add useful normal/empty/boundary tests, correct failures, and verify final exact source.

tools.name: apodexis_run
tools.description: Run complete checked source through main with JSON input and explicit limits. Supply all three limit fields: fuel, max_input_bytes, max_output_bytes. A typical limit object is {"fuel":100000,"max_input_bytes":1048576,"max_output_bytes":1048576}. Inspect status, output, diagnostics and fuel. Invalid typed input is an ABI error, not empty data; null means absent input only for no-parameter main. Execution has no ambient host access. Host-effect calls return capability_denied in MCP; use an operator-owned CLI policy for actual effects. For imports first use apodexis_bundle, then run its returned source.

tools.name: apodexis_apply_repairs
tools.description: Explicitly apply selected current compiler-issued repairs to exact source. Pass returned repair objects unchanged, the current exact source_text_hash as expected_source_text_hash, schema apodexis.apply_repairs_request.v1, and explicit allow_suggestive. Never invent repair IDs or reuse stale spans; read/check/verify the returned source before proceeding.

tools.name: apodexis_verify
tools.description: Primary authoring feedback loop: format, type-check, and run declared X tests on complete exact source. Top-level status ok is the combined verdict; inspect check diagnostics/repairs and test failures otherwise. Read the three spec resources first. Arithmetic and ordinary function calls remain prefix; use row.id and rows[index] for checked reads. Append with P out value, equivalent to S out (push out value); standalone calls are invalid statements. Prefer inferred locals for unambiguous initializers; keep function signatures, buf item types and context-free empty/variant locals typed. Short forms normalize to the established prefix canonical source. After each edit verify the new full source; main execution still requires apodexis_run. For multi-file programs first call apodexis_bundle and verify its returned source. Source tests execute without host capabilities.

tools.name: apodexis_pseudocode
tools.description: Render successfully checked source as deterministic human-readable pseudocode with structural node mappings. Use for comprehension/review; this neither generates missing code nor proves runtime behavior. Correct diagnostics and use apodexis_verify/apodexis_run for acceptance.

tools.name: apodexis_bundle
tools.description: Resolve a multi-file application from inline source and an explicit modules object mapping ASCII module keys to complete source strings. Use I alias "key", V symbol exports and alias::symbol qualified calls/types. No host source paths or automatic downloads. Returns assembled single-module source for verify/run; generated diagnostics refer to the assembled source. All selected dependencies and imported tests are included.
